shots.description: Bright noon chase in the sun: four stars, four cruisers in formation, seven traffic cars, ten pedestrians fleeing the raid cordon, raid danger zone and helipad in frame, big banner 'HEAT — FOUR STARS. THE WHOLE CITY IS WATCHING.'
Ocean Drive at bright noon — dry roads, blue water, Rico on foot by the beach, dialogue subtitle
Payback standoff in the plaza at noon — KING's ultimatum as a dialogue subtitle, the Kings in a ring with health bars, bonus objective on screen
The Big Score at bright noon: five stars, $5,250, amber getaway car, four cruisers in formation, explosion ahead, big banner 'THE BIG SCORE — FIVE STARS, $5,250 ON THE LINE.'
